Claim Notes

2023-08-28
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision while the vehicle was parked in a supermarket lot. The
claimant, who is not represented, gave a first account by phone and said they felt neck stiffness shortly after the
impact.
2023-09-24
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Requested the police
report and a copy of the scene photographs.
2023-09-30
Police report received and the reporting officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The other
driver's statement matches the claimant's description of how the impact occurred.
2023-10-04
Two independent witnesses were interviewed and both describe the collision as the claimant described it. Scene
photographs show damage that is mostly in line with the impact described.
2023-11-10
Claimant reported neck strain and was referred to a clinic for evaluation. The reported injury is plausible for a collision
of this kind and no earlier injury to the same area is known from the records available.
2024-02-03
Claimant called again to add a few small details about the seating position and the timing of the impact. The core
account has not changed since the first report.
2024-02-10
A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with body damage seevral weeks before the claimed date. The neighbor's
recollection is ucnonfirmed and no earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our files.
2024-02-28
Treatment followed a usual course and symptoms tapered off as the claimant improved. Repair estimate reviewed
and the cost is consistent with the damage shown in the photographs.
2024-03-03
File reviewed. Injury and vehicle damage are consistent with the reported collision and the claimant's account is
unchanged. The neighbor's comment is noted but not supported by other evidence, so the claim proceeds to
settlement review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
